title.narrative: Training Institute on Migration Capacity Partnership for the Mediterranean - II

description.narrative: The concrete objective of the project is to contribute to building migration capacity partnerships through the establishment of a permanent and accredited regional training institute offering quality-assured, bespoke learning and coaching experiences that result in certification for migration actors in line with global best practices for good governance. By doing so, the project aims to contribute to more effective administration of the movement of persons and goods and thus ultimately promoting the economic development and welfare of its Southern Partner Countries. While the training institute responsible for the EU accreditation of trainings will be located in Malta, the trainings will target migration actors in the project's Southern Partner Countries (including Jordan, Lebanon, Libya and Tunisia). To further localization, the project will accredit local training institutes in Southern Partner Countries with the aim of having the majority of trainings carried out locally.
